chunks: Humayd, from Ibn Sama'a, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Jameel, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

When the woman says, 'By Allah, I will not obey you in a matter, whether specified or unspecified,' it is permissible for him what he takes from her, and there is no right of reversion for him to her.

key_terms.خُلْعٌ: Compensatory divorce initiated by the wife

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the husband's compensation in khul'a if the wife declares she will not obey him?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Baqir (AS), the condition for the husband's retention of the khul'a compensation is the wife's explicit declaration of non-obedience, whether to a specific command or generally. This ruling underscores the contractual nature of khul'a in Shia jurisprudence, where the wife's autonomy in initiating separation is balanced by the forfeiture of the dower, distinguishing it from talaq al-sunnah where the husband retains the right of revocation (raj'ah).
